BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has executed share buybacks on August 11th, 13th, and 14th, 2026, purchasing a total of 805,875 ordinary shares. The average purchase price on August 11th was 266.30 pence, on August 13th it was 276.32 pence, and on August 14th it was 269.72 pence. Following these transactions, the company has 973,489,674 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and holds 29,256,340 shares in treasury. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 14 August 2026 14 August 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 29,256,340 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 14 August 2026 is 973,489,674 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 11 August 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 805,875 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
